note: Every rule that lives at the WRITER's boundary, in one document. This tier exists because no other tier reaches them: accept and format both RE-RENDER, and a re-render applies neither rounding nor shortening, so until this directory existed the whole of SPEC 4.5.4 was beyond the corpus and each implementation carried its own tests for it. THE TWO ELEVATION TIES ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE AND THE UGLY ONE IS THE LOAD-BEARING ONE. 340.25 to one place is 340.2 under round-half-to-even and 340.3 under round-half-away-from-zero, so it is the value that decides. 340.75 gives 340.8 under BOTH rules and decides nothing; it is here so that a reader cannot pass by rounding every tie upward. A fixture carrying only 340.75 would look like tie coverage and separate no readings at all - the same defect as the three-degree tolerance pair, where the number moved and the verdict did not. Do not drop 340.25 for being the awkward one. THE FIFTH CHANNEL IS DELIBERATE: SPEC 4.5.4 rounds longitude and latitude to 6 places and elevation to 1, and rounding is only definable where the units are known, so a channel this version does not name is written back unchanged - 0.98765432 survives verbatim while the elevation beside it rounds to 512.5. The negative zeros are ones the WRITER CREATES rather than ones it was handed: -0.00000004 and -0.04 carry no negative zero into the writer and would carry one out of it in most languages, and format/ can only ever supply -0.0 as an input literal. `hidden: false` must not be written; the declared version 0.1.99 must be written back rather than the reader's own; the interior null at pip 3 must not be shortened away, because dropping it would move the time into the elevation channel.
